d: Addressing the concluding day of the BJP's 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' rally in Haryana, Union Home Minister Amit Shah launched a sharp attack on Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and the Opposition. Rebutting allegations regarding the deletion of 13 crore voters, Shah offered a statistical breakdown, stating that 2.8 crore deceased individuals, over six crore voters relocated to other States, and one crore duplicate names were removed by the Election Commission. He claimed the remaining three crore names belonged to infiltrators enrolled by the Congress party.
